company.name: inai
company.shortDescription: Inai allows vendors to set up their payment stack with a single integration.
company.description: Inai is a single integration for your global payment stack. Inai will provide connections to multiple payment service providers ( Stripe, Adyen , Braintree), Wallets, BNPL platforms, open banking providers, fraud, BI and accounting in a single integration. Our dashboard will allow merchants to build custom workflows tailored to their unique business needs without writing any code

productsAndServices.description: A payment orchestration platform that connects merchants with payment vendors and local payment methods through a single integration, supporting pay-ins, pay-outs, localized checkout, and transaction routing.
productsAndServices.name: Orchestrate

productsAndServices.description: A payment analytics and observability product that provides transaction data, payment-stack analytics, and AI-based recommendations to identify authorization, performance, and cost opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Observe

productsAndServices.description: A payment reconciliation and fee-analysis product that consolidates transaction data from payment processors, identifies discrepancies, and provides detailed visibility into payment fees.
productsAndServices.name: Reconcile

productsAndServices.description: A failed-payment recovery service that uses automated, machine-learning-driven retry strategies to recover revenue, reduce involuntary churn, and improve retention for recurring and digital businesses.
productsAndServices.name: Revive

productsAndServices.description: A payment monitoring product that tracks payment metrics in real time, detects anomalies, and notifies teams so they can investigate and respond to performance issues.
productsAndServices.name: Alerts

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,547,302 to $22,416,784, a 6.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
